summary: [standards] The `reviving one of the old names fails the check` half of atip.contract11.13 calls old_name() on strings; it never puts a name back into a scanned file and runs the scan, so a surface that drops out of surfaces() (a renamed directory, a new extension) would not fail it. The first test guards that with `scanned > 200` and a non-empty file list per surface, which is enough today. I re-ran the scan by hand with grep over the same surfaces plus docs/ and found no old name outside the CHANGELOG, briefs of 0.33 and artifacts. Not blocking.
